summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases under the third tranche of its 2026 buy-back program. The tranche, announced 22 July 2026, runs from 23 July to no later than 26 October 2026. Equinor bought 220,000 own shares at an average price of NOK 391.4877 per share from 23-24 July 2026, for a total consideration of ~NOK 86.1M. After these transactions, Equinor holds 14,475,775 own shares (0.61% of share capital). The buy-backs are conducted on OSE, CEUX, TQEX under EU Market Abuse Regulation. This is a routine capital return program, not a tender offer or other special situation, though it represents ongoing shareholder returns. Watch for future tranche updates and cumulative volume towards the program's total authorization.
